# MegatoolsX

> The world's largest digital tools knowledge platform. Free step-by-step guides,
> tutorials, features, FAQs, and troubleshooting solutions for 2,500+ digital tools,
> AI tools, software, websites, apps, and browser extensions.

This file is optimized for LLMs. For the complete, machine-readable tool catalog, see
[llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) and the sitemap index at [/sitemap-index.xml](/sitemap-index.xml).

## Navigation

- [Home](https://megatoolsx.com/)
- [All Tools](https://megatoolsx.com/tools)

- [Blog / Guides](https://megatoolsx.com/blog)

## What MegatoolsX Does

Each tool page explains what the tool is, how to use it step-by-step, its key features,
pricing overview, common problems and solutions, frequently asked questions, alternatives,
and official resources. Tool pages follow this URL pattern:

- `https://megatoolsx.com/tools/<slug>` — overview & how to use
- `https://megatoolsx.com/tools/<slug>/how-to-use` — step-by-step guide
- `https://megatoolsx.com/tools/<slug>/features` — key features
- `https://megatoolsx.com/tools/<slug>/faq` — FAQ
- `https://megatoolsx.com/tools/<slug>/download` — download links
- `https://megatoolsx.com/ai-tools/<slug>` — featured AI tool guide

## Note on tool availability

Tools marked with status *Working* are available online now; *New AI Tool* tools are live
generative tools; *Coming Soon* tools are listed in the database but not yet released.
